findings.description: The described connected-sum sphere and unknot diagram is replaced by a red “diagram failed to render” box. The TikZ source specifies two punctured Poincare summands, a separating sphere, and the unknot in a ball in the left summand.
findings.repair_direction: Correct the TikZ parse error while preserving the two summand boxes, separating sphere, and unknot location.

findings.description: The Hopf-plumbing schematic is printed as literal TikZ source in the Diagram section; the snapshot uses a tilde-delimited `~~~tikz` fence. The intended two panels distinguish positive-positive trefoil bands from positive-negative figure-eight bands, with core intersection +1.
findings.repair_direction: Use the supported TikZ fence so both square-plumbing panels and their band/sign labels render.

findings.description: The cross-section sketch is printed as literal TikZ source after the Remarks text; the snapshot uses a tilde-delimited `~~~tikz` fence. The intended figure has one strand, a sheet below it, two side collars, and the level-sphere boundary.
findings.repair_direction: Use the supported TikZ fence to render the described strand, sheet, collar, and level sphere.

findings.description: The seam/stack schematic is replaced by a red “diagram failed to render” box. The surrounding text and TikZ labels specify adjacent copies Y_n and Y_{n+1}, the shared S_- / S_+ seam, and the positive meridian deck map t.
findings.repair_direction: Correct the TikZ parse error while preserving the adjacent-copy seam identification and positive meridian arrow.

findings.description: The three-stage cone-disk / 2-handle-core / slice-disk sketch is emitted as literal TikZ source in the Diagram section. The snapshot uses a tilde-delimited `~~~tikz` fence.
findings.repair_direction: Use the supported TikZ fence so the three construction stages and their common boundary labels render.

findings.description: The three schematic labels (“crossing”, “A-smoothing, weight A”, and “B-smoothing, weight A^{-1}”) crowd and overlap beneath their respective diagrams, so the labels are difficult to read.
findings.repair_direction: Increase panel spacing or reposition labels so each tangle and its weight can be read independently.

findings.description: Labels in the two-panel cable/JSJ schematic overlap each other and the panel content, obscuring the slope annotations and boundary labels described in the text.
findings.repair_direction: Give the two panels more room and separate slope, boundary, and piece labels while keeping the (2,1) lift and companion-torus cut data.

findings.description: The two displayed signature equalities appear as literal ASCII math (`sign(X)=...` and `sign_Γ^(2)(X)=...`) rather than typeset mathematics; the subscript/superscript syntax is visible as raw text.
findings.repair_direction: Wrap both signature equalities in math delimiters and use the intended ordinary and L^2 signature notation.
